experiments.headline: Latent causal residue
experiments.key_result: Present observational equivalence does not determine whether a hidden difference is inert, erased, or latent.

experiments.headline: Boundary-transferred latent residue
experiments.key_result: The interface relation r=p*s carries a joint-only predictive bit and supports exact ancestry recovery with retained polarity.

experiments.headline: Observable return without full-state return
experiments.key_result: Two return paths share the same endpoint observation and path product while retaining different hidden phase.

experiments.headline: Noncommuting interface order
experiments.key_result: Same interfaces plus same coarse endpoint can retain different hidden causal residue when order changes.
experiments.info: I(order;T|Y)=1 bit; unordered inventory contributes 0 bits

experiments.headline: Closed commutator loop
experiments.key_result: The declared observable returns after a closed loop while the full state retains nonzero loop residue.

experiments.headline: Oriented holonomy cancellation
experiments.key_result: CW and CCW loops are coarse-identical, leave different residues, and exactly cancel under inverse composition.

experiments.headline: Plaquette transport / curvature proxy
experiments.key_result: Neighboring local loops are nontrivial while the complete outer boundary is exactly trivial.

experiments.headline: Basepoint transport / local-to-global composition
experiments.key_result: Direct outer composition equals transported local composition in 12/12 frozen connectors; naive composition succeeds only in the 4 commuting controls.
experiments.info: G_boundary=(T B T^-1) A; naive BA is valid iff TB=BT

experiments.headline: Three-plaquette transport / composition order
experiments.key_result: Transported reconstruction and both parenthesizations match the direct outer boundary in 16/16 connector pairs; connector-free CBA succeeds only 1/16.
experiments.info: G_boundary=(T1 T2) C (T1 T2)^-1 (T1 B T1^-1) A

experiments.headline: Path compression / minimal connector memory
experiments.key_result: A task-specific residue with 13 classes is sufficient, while a cumulative descriptor with the same class count and entropy leaves 0.25 bits of uncertainty.

experiments.headline: Task-dependent memory
experiments.key_result: The coarsest sufficient preregistered memory descriptor changes with the future query family; expanding from the global-only query to the broad query family refines memory from 13 to 15 classes.
experiments.info: H(G|RΓ)=0; H(H2|RΓ)=0.25 bits; H(P2|RΓ)=0.25 bits; H(G|P2)=0.25 bits

experiments.headline: Authorized query memory
experiments.key_result: Restricted roles retain coarser sufficient memory than full capability memory; selected role descriptors have zero excess unauthorized leakage above the correlation floor in the frozen ensemble.

experiments.headline: Revocation and memory downgrade
experiments.key_result: Full-capability memory deterministically downgrades to role-specific memory while preserving authorized answers; a commitment to discarded old state can restore revoked distinctions in the tiny enumerable domain.
experiments.info: permission revoked != memory downgraded != secure erasure; new-state receipt adds no extra information; old-state receipt collapses revoked uncertainty to zero
